<section id="configuration">
<h1>Configuration</h1>
<p>WikiMason configuration uses TOML files. Configuration is resolved in this
precedence order:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p>Explicit <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--config</span> <span class="pre">/path/to/file.toml</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Local <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason.toml</span></code> (walked upwards from cwd)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--env</span> <span class="pre">NAME</span></code> → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">~/.config/wikimason/NAME.toml</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Default env <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">~/.config/wikimason/default.toml</span></code></p></li>
<li><p>Built-in defaults</p></li>
</ol>
<p>If both a local config and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--env</span></code> are present, the local config wins (it is
more specific to the project). A diagnostic is emitted when a local config
causes <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">--env</span></code> to be ignored.</p>
<section id="example">
<h2>Example</h2>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">config_version</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1</span>

<span class="k">[wiki]</span>
<span class="n">name</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;my_wiki&quot;</span>
<span class="n">profile</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;logseq&quot;</span>
<span class="n">root</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;~/Documents/Logseq/MyGraph&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[paths]</span>
<span class="n">raw</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Raw&quot;</span>
<span class="n">sources</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Raw/Sources&quot;</span>
<span class="n">files</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Raw/Files&quot;</span>
<span class="n">wiki</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Wiki&quot;</span>
<span class="n">schema</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Schema&quot;</span>
<span class="n">templates</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;_templates&quot;</span>
<span class="n">agents</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;AGENTS.md&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[links]</span>
<span class="n">style</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;wikilink&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[profile.logseq]</span>
<span class="n">flat_pages</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="n">namespace_separator</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;___&quot;</span>
<span class="n">property_style</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;logseq&quot;</span>
<span class="n">pages_dir</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;pages&quot;</span>

<span class="k">[profile.obsidian]</span>
<span class="n">hub_filename</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;_index.md&quot;</span>
<span class="n">nested_dirs</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="n">exclude</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">&quot;.obsidian/workspace.json&quot;</span><span class="p">]</span>

<span class="k">[profile.markdown]</span>
<span class="n">hub_filename</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;index.md&quot;</span>
<span class="n">nested_dirs</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>

</pre></div>

</pre></div>
</div>
</section>

<div class="highlight-bash notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span>wikimason<span class="w"> </span>config<span class="w"> </span>validate<span class="w"> </span>--format<span class="w"> </span>json
</pre></div>
</div>

</section>
<section id="logging">
<h2>Logging</h2>
<p>WikiMason supports configurable operational logging and rotation.</p>
<div class="highlight-toml notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="k">[logging]</span>
<span class="n">enabled</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="n">path</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Wiki/log.md&quot;</span>
<span class="n">mode</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;normal&quot;</span><span class="w">              </span><span class="c1"># quiet | normal | diagnostic</span>
<span class="n">min_level</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;info&quot;</span><span class="w">           </span><span class="c1"># info | warning | error</span>
<span class="n">include_audit_success</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">false</span>
<span class="n">include_metadata</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">false</span>
<span class="n">include_counts</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;non_clean&quot;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="c1"># never | non_clean | always</span>
<span class="n">max_summary_chars</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">160</span>
<span class="n">include_commands</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[]</span>
<span class="n">exclude_commands</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="p">[</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="s2">&quot;doctor&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="s2">&quot;vault.doctor&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="s2">&quot;links.check&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="s2">&quot;source.coverage&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="w">  </span><span class="s2">&quot;ingest.plan&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
<span class="p">]</span>

<span class="k">[logging.rotation]</span>
<span class="n">enabled</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kc">true</span>
<span class="n">strategy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;size&quot;</span><span class="w">            </span><span class="c1"># none | size</span>
<span class="n">max_bytes</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1048576</span>
<span class="n">max_files</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">5</span>
<span class="n">archive_dir</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">=</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="s2">&quot;Wiki/logs&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p>Behavior:</p>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mode</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">&quot;normal&quot;</span></code> logs changes and actionable/problem states with compact entries.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mode</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">&quot;diagnostic&quot;</span></code> logs full verbose audit/change entries (legacy shape).</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">mode</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">&quot;quiet&quot;</span></code> logs only warnings/errors/actionable/problem outcomes.</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">enabled</span> <span class="pre">=</span> <span class="pre">false</span></code> suppresses automatic logs, but <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">wikimason</span> <span class="pre">log</span> <span class="pre">add</span></code> still writes.</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
</section>
